description: This file defines the internal sealed class 'SiloConnection' which manages silo-to-silo network connections within the Orleans runtime. It handles message sending, receiving, ping responses, connection management, and message filtering logic.

classes.name: SiloConnection
classes.description: Manages network connection between silos, handling message transmission, reception, ping responses, and connection lifecycle within Orleans runtime.

methods.name: HandlePingMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming ping messages, responds if addressed to this silo, or forwards/rejects otherwise.

methods.name: FailMessage
methods.description: Handles message failure scenarios, including logging and rejection or dropping messages.

methods.name: RetryMessage
methods.description: Retries message sending up to a maximum number of attempts, or fails after exceeding retries.

methods.name: RunInternal
methods.description: Main execution loop for the connection, handling preamble reading/writing and connection lifecycle.

methods.name: PrepareMessageForSend
methods.description: Prepares a message for sending, ensuring it is valid and correctly addressed.
